description: Hail point history: Radar-detected hail signatures within a radius of a coordinate over the last N days (NOAA SWDI nx3hail). For roofing, claims and property agents that need a quick storm screen. Price: $0.10 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: detections, max size, days with hail, source URL.
name: x420_hail_point-history
